_comment: Manual override layer for the ingestion job (docs/RESEARCH.md section 7).
Scraped schedules break and government shutdowns reschedule releases, so
this file always wins over whatever the sources returned.
'remove' takes a list of event ids to drop from the feed.
'upsert' takes partial event objects; each one is merged over the event
with the same id, or appended whole if that id does not exist yet.
Every touched event is tagged "manually_overridden": true in the output.
